BIM can be a useful enabler for CE, especially when the latter is used to achieve a reduction in project duration and cost.
BIM can be used to facilitate concurrency in project implementation, and that BIM and CE are compatible and complementary.
the BIM implementation of the Chongqiag Jiangbei International Airport Terminal 3A project has achieved concurrency, and that this concurrency can be explained by CE.

how the use of BIM and CE in the design and construction of Terminal 3A has impacted the project.
how the use of BIM and CE can facilitate the delivery of projects in a more efficient and effective way.
how BIM can be used as an enabler of CE in AEC projects.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CE can be used as a framework to evaluate the success of a BIM project.
BIM-based project implementation is a form of CE.
BIM and CE are mutually reinforcing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

BIM-based projects are more likely to be successful if the following conditions are met: a) the project is large and complex; b) the project has a long construction period; c) the project is located in an area with a shortage of skilled labour; d) the project has an aggressive schedule; e) the project is a high-profile project; f) the project has multiple stakeholders; g) the project has many design iterations; and h) the project is subject to frequent change orders.
BIM-based project implementation is a form of CE and can be used to improve the quality of the built environment.

the BIM process is a viable method for implementing CE.
